LESSON: LISTENING FOR GIST: MAIN IDEA.

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ARABIC
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.1: Listening for gist: Main idea.
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening for gist: Main idea., part of Listening and Speaking in Grade 8 ARABIC.

Key inquiry question: Why do we greet one another?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to an audio recording on greetings in informal and formal situations,

2. pick out the main ideas from the recording,

3. list specific greetings and their responses from a recording,

4. collaborate with peers to role- play formal and informal greetings with different gender,

5. engage in a singing game on various greetings with peers.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to an audio recording on greetings in informal and formal situations,
2. pick out the main ideas from the recording,
3. list specific greetings and their responses from a recording,
4. collaborate with peers to role- play formal and informal greetings with different gender,
5. engage in a singing game on various greetings with peers.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening for gist: Main idea. together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: These are enhanced as the learner works jointly with peers to role-play formal and

informal greetings with different genders.

• Digital literacy: This is enhanced as the learner interacts with digital content when listening to an audio recording on

greetings in informal and formal situations.

with different genders.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Gender issues: These are addressed as the learner appreciates various greetings used across the various genders.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner is able to relate the concept on greetings and introduction to their learning of introduction of self and others in
